summary: The catalog page grid of categories and/or collections. System section.
rules: Tile ratio is set by the theme (`collectionSnippet.aspectRatio`).
`source: categories` when collections are merchandising shelves (new, sale) rather than browse structure.

`alignTitle` is `default` (as in the theme), `left` or `center`, and the schema requires it: presets write `default`, so a starter template's stored `left` does not survive under a centred theme. An older storefront build knows only `left` and `center`; there pass `--schema` with the store's skeleton and `presets apply` keeps the stored value.
A catalog of one category looks empty: a one-category store shows a product shelf of that category instead.

Covers, names and the category tree are cabinet data: seeded names («Категория 1-го уровня», «Полка 1»), one photo as the cover of several categories and `source: all` mixing merchandising collections into browse are merchant tasks.

presets.name: catalog-captioned-grid
presets.use: Default /catalog: captions centred under the image, 4 per row.
presets.evidence: captions under the image in 22 stores; centred captions in about 3 in 10 catalog pages
fill: `title`: keep the pulled title or use «Каталог».

presets.name: catalog-editorial-left
presets.use: Default /catalog for left-aligned themes: captions under the image, left-aligned, 4 per row.
presets.evidence: left captions under the image in about 1 in 3 catalog pages
fill: `title`: keep the pulled title or use «Каталог».

presets.name: catalog-overlay-3col
presets.use: Strong category photography: white titles on darkened tiles, 3 per row.
presets.evidence: every overlay catalog in the sample switched the darkening off, and their white captions disappear on light photos: keep it on

presets.name: catalog-quiet-luxe
presets.use: Premium catalogs: centred larger captions in a regular weight, more air above.
fill: `title`: keep the pulled title or use «Каталог».
